info.title: Janus — corporate API gateway
info.description: Janus is an authenticated, metered gateway between an organisation's people and its approved AI providers. It exposes three surfaces: an OpenAI-compatible proxy under /v1 (bearer token auth — point any OpenAI SDK at PUBLIC_URL/v1), a first-party application API under /api/v1 (session cookie + CSRF header), and an admin API under /api/v1/admin (admin session). This document is served by the gateway itself at /openapi.json, so it always matches the running build.

patch.summary: Edit model alias, context, per-field pricing overrides, or status
patch.description: Atomic edit of alias, status, context and any of five prices. Each metadata field: omitted preserves; numeric value sets an admin override; null independently resets to automatic (upstream > provider-scoped exact reference > unknown). Context zero explicitly means unknown; a price zero explicitly means free. The native model ID cannot change. Rates and history commit together. Invalid fields reject the whole request. Alias is trimmed/lowercased and must use valid routing characters. Existing enable and dependent-managed-model guards remain. On success returns {model: CatalogModel}; metadata includes source/override/automatic values.

Metadata only — request and response bodies are never stored. Admins may widen the scope: scope=all lists every user's requests and user_id=<id> narrows to one user (user_id wins when both are sent). Cross-user responses attach the owning user's identity to each event as user_email and user_name; non-admins always receive only their own events regardless of these parameters. Events also carry client_app: the calling application (agent harness, IDE plugin, app) when it identifies itself via X-Janus-Agent, X-OpenRouter-Title, X-Title, or HTTP-Referer. It is empty when the client sends no attribution header — client_user_agent only ever names the SDK. Service-token events carry an empty user_id plus service_token_id/service_token_name; filter the two populations apart with principal=users|service_tokens.

team_id.description: Target team ID, or empty for Personal.

move_history.description: Explicit choice: also move already recorded requests for this token.

200.description: Affinity and optional usage reassignment committed atomically.

400.description: Missing explicit choice, revoked token, or invalid target.

403.description: Browser session required.

bearerToken.description: API token created on the Tokens page. Only its SHA-256 digest is stored server-side.

sessionCookie.description: Browser session established by /auth. Mutating requests must also echo the janus_csrf cookie value in the X-Janus-CSRF header.

scimBearer.description: Dedicated administrator-issued scim_ provisioning secret. Required even for discovery. Application API keys, service tokens and sessions are not accepted; this is not an OAuth issuance endpoint.

Forbidden.description: Refused by role, grant, delegation, or policy rule (permission_error, policy.model_not_granted, policy.endpoint_blocked, policy.user_disabled).

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is outside the caller's scope.

LimitExceeded.description: Quota or rate limit exceeded (policy.quota_exceeded, policy.rate_limit, upstream.rate_limit). Retry after the reset.

UpstreamUnavailable.description: The provider behind the model could not be reached (upstream.unavailable).

ManagedModelFallbackExhausted.description: The managed model's target is unavailable AND its configured fallback cannot take over (missing or disabled). Error code policy.managed_model_fallback_exhausted; the message names both faults.

Error.description: OpenAI-compatible error envelope. See /docs/api/errors for the full catalog.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI chat-completion request. Forwarded verbatim; only `model` is inspected for routing and policy.

subject_type.description: Ignored on the lead surface — the subject is always the team in the path.

alert_thresholds.description: Warning-alert percentages for this rule. Omit to keep the current value; an empty list restores the 80/95 defaults. A breach alert always fires at 100% regardless of this list.

UsageTotals.description: Aggregated usage counters over a window or bucket.

TimePoint.description: One bucket in a usage time series.

managed_models.description: Servable managed aliases granted to the caller, each naming its current target.

CatalogModel.description: A real catalog model the caller may use, with pricing and live health.

id.description: Stable model id; grants, quotas, and rate cards join on it.

display_name.description: Admin-set alias shown to users; empty when never renamed.

rate_in_nanousd.description: Input rate in nano-USD per million tokens.

rate_out_nanousd.description: Output rate in nano-USD per million tokens.

rate_cached_nanousd.description: Cached-input rate in nano-USD per million tokens.

rate_cache_write_5m_nanousd.description: 5-minute prompt-cache write rate in nano-USD per million tokens.

rate_cache_write_1h_nanousd.description: 1-hour prompt-cache write rate in nano-USD per million tokens.

rate_effective_from.description: When the current rate card took effect.

discovered_at.description: When discovery last saw the model.

grant_count.description: Number of grants on the model.

grant_source.description: How the caller obtained access (direct, group, all users, …).

request_count_10m.description: Requests addressed to this model in the trailing 10 minutes that reached or tried to reach the upstream. Policy rejections are excluded.

error_count_10m.description: Upstream-attributable failures among request_count_10m: any 5xx (including the 503 recorded when the provider is unreachable) or an upstream.* error code.

error_rate_percent.description: error_count_10m / request_count_10m × 100, rounded to one decimal; 0 when there was no traffic.

upstream_reachable.description: True when the owning upstream's most recent health probe succeeded. False before the first probe.

upstream_last_check_at.description: Time of the most recent upstream probe; Go zero time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) when never probed.

upstream_last_error.description: Error from the most recent upstream probe; empty when it succeeded.

upstream_last_latency_ms.description: Latency of the most recent successful upstream probe in milliseconds.

health.description: Derived verdict. down: the upstream probe failed, or ≥3 requests in the window all failed. degraded: error_rate_percent ≥ 10 with traffic. unknown: never probed and no traffic. healthy: otherwise.

metadata.description: Keys: context_window and rate_{in,out,cached,cache_write_5m,cache_write_1h}_nanousd. Prefer nullable metadata values over legacy numeric zero sentinels.

metadata_warnings.description: Unsupported/conditional pricing or invalid provider prices; no guessed conversion is applied.

effective_minutes.description: Cadence the scheduler honours right now.

updated_at.description: When the override was last saved; absent when none.

ModelMetadataField.description: Resolved metadata in tokens (context) or nano-USD per million tokens (prices). Null is unknown; zero is explicit. Automatic values are retained beneath overrides.

rate_in_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million tokens. Omit to preserve; null removes this override; zero sets an explicit free price. Rounded to integer nano-USD; must fit signed int64.

rate_out_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million tokens. Omit to preserve; null removes this override; zero sets an explicit free price. Rounded to integer nano-USD; must fit signed int64.

rate_cached_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million tokens. Omit to preserve; null removes this override; zero sets an explicit free price. Rounded to integer nano-USD; must fit signed int64.

rate_cache_write_5m_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million tokens. Omit to preserve; null removes this override; zero sets an explicit free price. Rounded to integer nano-USD; must fit signed int64.

rate_cache_write_1h_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million tokens. Omit to preserve; null removes this override; zero sets an explicit free price. Rounded to integer nano-USD; must fit signed int64.

context_window.description: Tokens. Omit to preserve; null resets to automatic; zero explicitly overrides to unknown.

display_name.description: Caller-facing alias; empty string clears it. Trimmed/lowercased and validated for routing and uniqueness.

effective_from.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for a price version; defaults to now.

source_id.description: Empty for manual; Janus group ID for group source.

can_manage.description: Included in directory entries; current viewer can administer this team.

pending_request_count.description: Directory only: included for managers, omitted for ordinary members and nonmembers.

csv.description: Exact headers Team_name,Team_admin,Additional_members; semicolon-separated additional emails. At most 1000 data rows; entire JSON request at most 2 MiB.

team_id.description: Immutable binding; empty means Personal. Never inherited from the browser context.

revoked_at.description: Empty string when active, RFC 3339 timestamp when revoked.

created_at.description: Unset values use the zero timestamp, not null.

expires_at.description: Unset values use the zero timestamp, not null.

revoked_at.description: Unset values use the zero timestamp, not null.

last_used_at.description: Unset values use the zero timestamp, not null.

secret.description: Provisioning secret returned exactly once on creation or successful rotation; absent from list results.

status.description: HTTP status serialized as a string.

schemas.description: Must include core User schema. Enterprise attributes require the enterprise schema in this array.

active.description: Defaults to true if omitted, including PUT replacement. Set false explicitly to keep a user disabled.

value.description: Existing SCIM User ID; member identity immutable.

type.description: User, case-insensitive; omitted or empty also means User. Nested groups rejected.

value.description: Existing SCIM User ID; member identity immutable.

type.description: User, case-insensitive; omitted or empty also means User. Nested groups rejected.

path.description: Known writable attribute path; selector filters supported. May be omitted for object-valued add/replace.

value.description: Operation value; shape depends on target attribute.

grantee_id.description: Required for user/group/service_token/team; must identify an existing grantee.

GrantInput.description: At least one model_id/model_ids entry required; all target models validated before writes.

team_id.description: Nonempty exactly for team scope; empty otherwise.

start.description: RFC3339 timestamp required for custom period; empty/omitted for named periods. [start,end), positive, at most 366 elapsed days.

end.description: RFC3339 timestamp required for custom period; empty/omitted for named periods. [start,end), positive, at most 366 elapsed days.

source_period.description: Optional origin of a frozen custom interval; preserves calendar comparisons across DST/month lengths. Enqueue populates it.

timezone.description: Explicit IANA timezone; empty and Local are rejected.

filters.description: AND across dimensions; values select allowed dimension values. Unknown keys or empty arrays rejected.

scenario_discount_percent.description: Hypothetical estimate only; not billing or realized savings.

ReportingDefinition.description: Versioned report definition. Ad-hoc requests require explicit fields, not automatic template defaults. Shared definitions grant no data access. dimensions.description: Stable dimension keys/values plus optional display-label keys such as model_label; unknown attribution is not inferred.

comparison_reliable.description: Present for comparisons. False means numeric deltas and outlier claims are withheld because coverage is incomplete; recorded prior totals remain available.

comparison_warnings.description: Prior-period coverage and measurement-confidence notices, also included in report warnings.

ReportingResult.description: Frozen result: null numeric values mean unavailable; rates are ratios. Includes all rows, sections, units and coverage warnings. Local-only responses/downloads redact monetary data and potentially monetary free text.

id.description: Section IDs include generated analyses beyond template family IDs; not restricted to the catalog family enum.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision; submit the last returned value on update or receive 409.

result.description: Only present for complete, unexpired detail responses; omitted from run lists.

ReportRun.description: Persisted frozen definition and optional result. Lease tokens are never serialized. Empty lifecycle timestamps serialize as Go zero date-times. Expires after 30 days, reset at finalization. Retry creates a new run under the requester.

ReportModelClassification.description: Explicit administrator labels; blank values are unknown. Changes affect future admissions only. Unclassified inventory entries have a zero updated_at timestamp.

revision.description: Accepted but ignored on create; persisted revision starts at 1.
Current revision required to succeed; omission defaults to zero and conflicts.

report_id.description: Optional saved-report association. Access to it is checked; the provided definition is still required and is what executes.

ReportScheduleWrite.description: Full replacement. Monthly frequency requires monthday 1..28. Saved report must be owned by schedule owner and authorized; an existing report association cannot change (409). DST gaps skipped, folds choose earliest instant; latest missed occurrence only.

name.description: Nonblank after trimming; at most 200 bytes.

subject_id.description: Required and nonempty for user/team; empty for organization. Scope and subject immutable on update.

ReportBudgetWrite.description: Reporting-only budget, no enforcement. Positive interval; start nonzero, years 1..9999; unlike custom report definitions, no 366-day budget limit. Zero amount is allowed.

family.description: Printable UTF-8, at most 100 bytes; blank is unknown.

provider.description: Printable UTF-8, at most 100 bytes; blank is unknown.

ReportClassificationWrite.description: Replacement labels for future request snapshots only. Omitted fields become blank; an empty object clears all labels. Shared decoder rejects unknown fields and reads through a 4 MiB limit; unlike ordinary reporting decoder it does not check for a second JSON value.

ReportOptions.description: Retained authorized dimension domain, not a rolling time window; also includes currently authorized teams without prior use. Hard input limit fails rather than truncates.
